newsitem.title: USA: Sara Lee's Coach mulls Mark Cross sale.
newsitem.headline: Sara Lee's Coach mulls Mark Cross sale.

text.p: Sara Lee Corp.'s Coach division is exploring the possible sale of its Mark Cross leather goods business, a spokesman said Monday.
"In February, employees were told that Coach was exploring alternatives for the Mark Cross business and that sale was one of those alternatives," said Sara Lee spokesman Jeffrey Smith.
No developments have been announced since the advisory was sent to employees, he said.

Sara Lee's Coach and Mark Cross leather divisions are managed as a group, with Coach overseeing the Mark Cross operation. The group generated about $500 million in sales for the year ended July 1, 1996.

Sara Lee has owned New York-based Mark Cross since 1993. Mark Cross makes handbags, wallets, briefcases and other leather accessories. Sara Lee's stock rose 37.5 cents to $42 on the New York Stock Exchange at mid-afternoon.
